rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + ZIP and matched to a single user. The agent accurately identified the delivered items for return and obtained explicit confirmation before submitting the return requests; those returns were executed correctly and refunds routed to the original PayPal method. However, the user requested to cancel only the newly ordered garden hose and explicitly indicated that if single‑item cancellation wasn’t possible, they did not want anything else canceled. The agent stated they would cancel only the garden hose item in the pending order, but then executed a full cancellation of the entire order #W2575533 without clarifying that only whole‑order cancellation was possible and without obtaining explicit consent for canceling all items. This violates the requirement to state the exact change and get confirmation before writes, and it contravenes the user’s stated constraint. The refund total provided matches the (incorrect) action taken, but the action itself was not compliant with the policy or the user’s intent.
